snippet.title: Backrooms Lost Runners | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Step into the Backrooms — where fear has no boundaries.
Get ready for Backrooms Lost Runners, an atmospheric horror game that will take you deep into a surreal nightmare. Are you prepared to uncover the secrets and survive the unknown?

STEAM:https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072120/Backrooms_Lost_Runners/?utm_source=youtube

What’s in this teaser:
    A chilling first look at the eerie Backrooms.
    Immersive visuals and spine-tingling atmosphere.
    A cryptic hint of the story that will keep you on edge.

Subscribe to ShimStudio for more trailers and updates. The Backrooms are waiting.
Don’t miss the official release coming soon!
